case.title: CASE 0017 · TERMINATION RECORD
case.body:
SUBJECT: JAVIS
STATUS: DECEASED
CAUSE: DIMENSIONAL DISPLACEMENT
TERMINATION: 17 OCTOBER, 02:14 AM

[ANOMALY DETECTED]
The recorded termination date lies in the future.

[UNRESOLVED]
Who authored this record?
case.established: Case 0017 lists Javis as deceased at a time that has not yet occurred.
case.note: The restricted archive contains a future-dated death certificate for Javis.

revisions.title: ARCHIVE REVISIONS 02 / 03
revisions.body:
REVISION 02: Javis photographed from behind inside a locked archive.
REVISION 03: A second Javis appears in the doorway.

MESSAGE: THE FIRST VERSION HAS ALREADY BEEN REPLACED.

ANOMALY: The images appear to anticipate or rewrite events.
revisions.note: The archive's photographs change, including one showing a second Javis.

family.title: PERSONAL ARCHIVE · CORRUPTION
family.body:
IMAGE SERIES: FAMILY / PERSONAL
CORRUPTION: ONE FACE ONLY

All images retain sharp backgrounds. The same woman's face is consistently absent.

CALL LOG: HOME / NO VALID HISTORY

ANOMALY: Personal records are being altered.
family.note: Javis's mother's face has been erased from photographs, and a phone contact disappears.

attempts.title: SUBJECT RECOVERY HISTORY
attempts.body:
SUPERVISING OFFICER: ARIS THORNE
PRIOR ATTEMPTS: 16
CURRENT CASE: 0017

A sequence of records depicts Javis in different apparent deaths. One archive photograph carries a timestamp already in the past.

ANOMALY: Why does Javis remember none of them?
attempts.established: The recovery history names Aris Thorne and lists sixteen prior attempts.
attempts.note: Thorne is listed as supervising officer; sixteen earlier attempts are recorded.

tablet.title: UNIDENTIFIED ARTIFACT
tablet.body:
LOCATION: SUBLEVEL / UNIVERSITY LIBRARY
OBJECT: BLACK TABLET / GOLDEN GLYPHS

REPORTED PHENOMENA:
MEMORY IMAGES, DIRECT COGNITIVE COMMUNICATION, TEMPORAL STASIS.

IDENTITY: UNKNOWN

ANOMALY: The object appears to remember Javis.
tablet.note: The black tablet appears to preserve memories that Javis has lost.

photo.title: RECOVERED PHOTOGRAPH
photo.body:
RECOVERY LOCATION: SERVICE ALLEY
SUBJECTS: JAVIS / SECOND JAVIS

The image shows two versions of Javis in the same location. One appears visibly afraid. The image's origin is unknown.

UNRESOLVED: What makes this version different, and who left the photograph?
photo.note: A photograph shows two versions of Javis. Its origin and the meaning of its message remain unknown.

iteration.title: CONTINUUM FRAGMENT · ITERATION 017
iteration.body:
SUBJECT DESIGNATION: J-17
STATUS: UNRESOLVED
CONTINUITY VARIANCE: CRITICAL

ITERATIONS 014–016: FAILED
ITERATION 017: PENDING / CORRECTION INITIATED

ACCESS: OBSERVER AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED

LIMITATION: This fragment is incomplete and may not reliably describe what the Continuum is attempting.
iteration.established: The fragment records an unresolved continuity variance and a pending correction.
iteration.note: A partial Continuum record links Iteration 017 to an unresolved continuity variance. It does not establish what the iteration means.

observer_deduction.title: AUTOMATED CORRELATION
observer_deduction.body:
CODEX SYSTEM NOTICE:

Previous data transmitted by Observer has been cross-referenced.

RESULT: The Continuum's 'Iteration 017' file contradicts the physical evidence recovered in the archive.

The records disagree about Javis’s status. The Continuum’s intentions remain unverified.
observer_deduction.note: The Codex correlated transmitted data and identified a discrepancy; the underlying cause remains unresolved.

spindle.title: MEMORY SPINDLE
spindle.body:
RECOVERED FROM: MARA VOSS
STATUS: SHATTERED

The spindle contained a preserved memory state. Playback revealed a recording of Cassius and Elara.

KEY PHRASE: "You were never the mistake."

LIMITATION: The record fractured during playback. Full context remains inaccessible.
spindle.note: The memory spindle revealed a fragment of Javis's parents' past, and a final message from his mother.

brass_wheel.title: THE BRASS WHEEL
brass_wheel.body:
RECOVERED FROM: MARA VOSS'S WORKSHOP

A small brass wheel, perfectly fitted and undamaged.

It matches a broken wheel Mara has kept for twelve years — except the brass one is intact.

MANUFACTURER'S MARK:
A company that closed forty years ago. They never manufactured clock parts.

ANOMALY: Javis did not repair the wheel. He brought an intact one from somewhere else.
brass_wheel.note: A brass wheel brought from another possibility. Its manufacturer never made clock parts.

notebook.title: THE STRANGER'S NOTEBOOK
notebook.body:
A small, battered notebook filled with handwriting.

Dates. Times. Names.

Some passages have been crossed out so heavily that the paper has torn.

FIRST PAGE:
Do not trust the version of events that makes everything simple.

LAST KNOWN ENTRY:
This time, he remembers.

ANOMALY: The handwriting matches records associated with Elara.
notebook.note: A notebook filled with the stranger's attempts to remember what the Codex already knows.

watch.title: THE BRASS WATCH
watch.body:
OBJECT: BRASS WATCH
ENGRAVING: J & A
STOPPED AT: 02:14 AM

Thorne claims he gave this watch to Javis. It contains a manufacturer's mark that predates the current timeline.

UNRESOLVED: Why does it have two sets of initials?
watch.note: A brass watch stopped at the exact time of Javis's predicted death, engraved with initials that shouldn't exist yet.

nightingale.title: NIGHTINGALE — PROTOTYPE 03
nightingale.body:
RECOVERED FROM: CONTINUUM EQUIPMENT TRANSFER RECORD

DESIGNED BY: M. VOSS
CALIBRATED BY: C. VALE
STATUS: DECOMMISSIONED (THEN REBUILT)

FUNCTION: Detects the consequences of an exchange, not the person responsible.

UNRESOLVED: Why was Prototype 03 rebuilt three months after Voss's death?
nightingale.note: Nightingale was built to detect exchange consequences. Its calibration was later revised by Cassius Vale.

annex_shipment.title: ANNEX C SHIPMENT NOTICE
annex_shipment.body:
HISTORICAL RECORDS TRANSFER
REFERENCE: HR-017
DESTINATION (REVISED): ARCHIVE RECONCILIATION UNIT — ANNEX C
DESTINATION (ORIGINAL): CENTRAL REPOSITORY

APPROVED BY: DR. SELENE ARDENT
APPROVAL DATE: PREDATES DOCUMENT CREATION

ANOMALY: The authorization was reused.
annex_shipment.note: The shipment's destination was altered from the Central Repository to Annex C. The authorization predates the record.

demolition.title: DEMOLITION NOTICE — ANNEX C
demolition.body:
ANNEX C — DEMOLITION COMPLETED
DATE: SIX MONTHS PRIOR

SOURCE: UNIVERSITY MAINTENANCE RECORDS
PHOTOGRAPHS: CLEARED FOUNDATION. TEMPORARY FENCE.

ANOMALY: The building was present last night.
demolition.note: Official records claim Annex C was demolished six months ago. It was there last night.

reed_report.title: TOMAS REED — INCIDENT REPORT (ORIGINAL)
reed_report.body:
REPORTING OFFICER: TOMAS REED
LOCATION: WESTERN SERVICE GATE
INCIDENT: Unauthorized vehicle observed near vacant construction site.

SUPPLEMENTARY EVIDENCE: Photograph attached.

STATUS: Under review.
reed_report.note: Tomas Reed's original incident report, documenting the delivery to Annex C.

reed_statement.title: TOMAS REED — PRIVATE STATEMENT
reed_statement.body:
PRIVATE INCIDENT STATEMENT — TOMAS REED

I do not know who the people in the vehicle were. I do not know what they were carrying. I only know that the building was there, and that I saw them enter it.

I am writing this because I have been asked to withdraw my account. I will not sign a statement saying I imagined something I know I saw.
reed_statement.note: Tomas Reed's private statement, preserved outside the university's official record system.

reconciliation_request.title: RECONCILIATION REQUEST — HR-017
reconciliation_request.body:
HISTORICAL RECONCILIATION REQUEST
REFERENCE: HR-017
INITIATING OFFICER: INSPECTOR SOREN

JUSTIFICATION:
UNVERIFIED HISTORICAL OBSERVATION
POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION OF CIVILIAN MEMORY
RECOMMENDED ACTION: LIMITED RECONCILIATION

SUPPORTING EVIDENCE: Transport record (Cassius Vale investigation).

STATUS: Suspended pending review.
reconciliation_request.note: Soren initiated the reconciliation request against Tomas Reed's memory, citing the disputed shipment record as evidence.

cas_shipment.title: CASSIUS VALE — SHIPMENT AUTHORIZATION
cas_shipment.body:
HISTORICAL TRANSFER AUTHORIZATION
REFERENCE: HR-017
SUBJECT: CASSIUS VALE INVESTIGATION

AUTHORIZED BY: DR. SELENE ARDENT
APPROVAL DATE: [PREDATES DOCUMENT CREATION]

ANOMALY: The signature belongs to Dr. Ardent, but the authorization was copied from another record.
cas_shipment.note: The shipment authorization bears Dr. Ardent's signature, but she states it was reused from another record.

admission_register.title: ORIGINAL ADMISSION REGISTER
admission_register.body:
SUBJECT J-17 — ORIGINAL ADMISSION RECORD

ENTRY A: [ACTIVE]
ENTRY B: TRANSFERRED TO PROTECTIVE CUSTODY

Both entries bear the same name.
Both carry the same date of birth.
Both signed by Aris Thorne.
Different identification numbers.

ANOMALY: Two subjects, one identity.
admission_register.note: The admission register records two subjects with the same name, same birth date, and different identification numbers.

plate.title: THE BRASS IDENTIFICATION PLATE
plate.body:
CONTINUITY PRESERVATION UNIT
SUBJECT A — RETAINED
SUBJECT B — TRANSFERRED

The plate was hidden beneath the examination table in the preservation laboratory. It confirms Thorne's admission that two subjects were recorded.

ANOMALY: The identification numbers match the admission register.
plate.note: The brass plate hidden in the lab proves that two subjects were officially recorded by the preservation unit.

correction_logs.title: ORIGINAL CORRECTION LOGS
correction_logs.body:
CORRECTION 004
TARGET CONTINUITY: A
RESULT: SUBJECT REMOVED
HISTORICAL RECONCILIATION: COMPLETE

UNREGISTERED CONTINUITY DETECTED
ORIGIN MATCH: PRIOR SUBJECT

CORRECTION 005
TARGET CONTINUITY: B
RESULT: SUBJECT REMOVED
HISTORICAL RECONCILIATION: COMPLETE

PATTERN: Every successful removal was followed by an unregistered return.
correction_logs.note: The original correction logs show that each successful removal of one continuity was followed by the other's return.

cassius_letter.title: CASSIUS'S LETTER
cassius_letter.body:
FOR THE CHILD WHO RETURNS

My son,

I don't know whether this letter will ever reach you.

...If there is more than one of you, then I have more than one son.

I won't ask either of you to disappear for the sake of the other.

I'm sorry I brought this upon you.

Your father,
Cassius.
cassius_letter.note: Cassius wrote this letter before the second child appeared, acknowledging that there might be two.

cassius_recording.title: PRESERVATION OBSERVATION — SESSION 01
cassius_recording.body:
RECOVERED FROM: PRESERVATION LABORATORY
DATE: THREE YEARS AFTER INITIAL RETURN

A child on the examination table.
A second child behind the observation window.
Same face. Same approximate age. Different clothes.

The child behind the window speaks:
"I came back."

ANOMALY: The second child was not formally registered until three years later.
cassius_recording.note: The recording shows two children in the preservation laboratory. The second speaks: 'I came back.'

exchange_indicator.title: THE EXCHANGE INDICATOR
exchange_indicator.body:
RECOVERED FROM: CASSIUS VALE'S PRIVATE ROOM

A small instrument with a transparent casing and a narrow blue filament.

The filament responds to Javis and Aren independently. It divides when both are present.

FUNCTION: Detects exchange states without requiring a completed transfer.

ANOMALY: It responds to both subjects, confirming they can both influence exchange states.
exchange_indicator.note: Cassius's exchange indicator responds to both Javis and Aren, confirming that both can influence exchange states.

portable_unit.title: PORTABLE REFERENCE UNIT — CRU-04
portable_unit.body:
MODEL: CRU-04
STATUS: DECOMMISSIONED
DESTINATION: STATION NINE
TRANSFER DATE: THREE MONTHS PRIOR
AUTHORIZATION: WITHHELD

FUNCTION: Maintains an independent continuity reference without consulting the central identity registry.

REQUIREMENT: The reference must be independently established.
portable_unit.note: The portable reference unit could maintain Aren's continuity independently — but only if his reference is established independently first.

station_nine_archive.title: STATION NINE — MONITORING ARCHIVE
station_nine_archive.body:
ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING ANNEX — STATION 09

PRESERVED BY: ELIAS VENN

Contains:
- Raw Nightingale measurements
- Correction disturbance records
- Exchange-debt monitoring data

STATUS: Partially preserved. Live comparisons not preserved.
station_nine_archive.note: Elias Venn preserved Station Nine's monitoring archive, documenting the consequences of the Continuum's corrections.

record_released.title: CONTRADICTION RELEASED
record_released.body:
OBSERVER DIRECTIVE LOGGED:

ACTION: CONTRADICTION PRESERVED.

Both the Continuum's record and the independent observation have been released to external verification channels. The contradiction can now be independently examined.

WARNING: A trace request has been initiated against the source of the independent observation. The request does not prove that the source has been identified.
record_released.note: You released the contradictory records. The public case is stronger, and the source-tracing risk has increased.

witness_protected.title: WITNESS RECORD SECURED
witness_protected.body:
OBSERVER DIRECTIVE LOGGED:

ACTION: WITNESS RECORD PROTECTED.

The contradictory observation remains sealed within the Codex and is not available as openly verifiable evidence.

This directive does not retract findings transmitted earlier or guarantee that the Observer cannot be traced through other records.
witness_protected.note: The witness observation remains sealed. Source protection depends on what was transmitted earlier and what other evidence exists.

thadmission.title: THORNE'S ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT
thadmission.body:
CONTINUITY RECOVERY PROGRAMME
PERSONAL ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT
AUTHOR: PROFESSOR ARIS THORNE
SUBJECT: CORRECTIONS 001–017

Thorne identifies the custody transfers, the correction attempts, the failures, and his own involvement.

He requests independent review rather than unrestricted publication.
thadmission.note: Thorne submitted a signed accountability statement identifying his role in the original correction programme.
